main_text.p: vinoimbuto, prout quifq; voluerit vel affue-uerit. Vacuato enim ventre & tamé dolore nó remittente, vini noxam potum vini eiufdem (non quidem fpecie) eluere nó fine ratione af-feuero: quia Aduini pimirū, quæ mala calidæ tenuifq; fuæ fubftantiæ copiá inuexit, eadem fua quali-tate & vicalefaciendi exiccandiq; viciffim tol-lit, eo inquam modo vapores craffos nebulo-fosq; difpergit, quo dolores oculorum inde ortos fcripfit Hip.fe.6.l.2. Epidem. meracá po-tione difcuti. Contrarium verò fi euenerit, id eft, fi vini noxam vini potio non tollit, malum & rectudefcit & augetur,

Vomere autem vél non valentibus, vel mo-leftè & difficulter vomentibus ieiunium & in-ediam optimum effe remediū experientia te-ftis eft, fomnum prææerea, quietem optimam, ventriculi fomentü & linimentum, quibus e-goaddo leuem frictionem capitis & ventris, Sæpe fruftra tentantur omnia vaporibus fcili-cet craffis & crudis in venas, cerebri profun-dum, &neruorum fubftantiam relapfis, cumq; fpiritibus mixtis, vnde torpidi, obfcuri, ingna-uiqueredditi laffitudinem illam membrorum tantifper fouent, dum per motum vapor ille fuerit difperfus atque refolutus. Itaq; mo-tionem & obambulationem diuturniorem & paulò celeriorem ante cibum plurimum plurimis hic prodeffe & profuiffe in experi-mentis eft, à cibo autem lentiorem & bre-uiorem.

page.notes: Left margin, printed in small italic beside the first lines: "Aduini", "noxam", "eiufdem", "potio per", "fanet" (the last two partly cut off at the edge). Only the first is reliably read; the rest are marked as catchwords or cross-references and are left as printed in the margin. The word "vinoimbuto" is read as printed. The running head at the top is uncertain. The reading of the bottom line "uiorem" is taken from the last printed line of the text.
